verdict.rationale: API versioning and deprecation policy are a fair question for a subscription-billing SaaS. The evidence pack covers official client libraries, mobile SDKs and an MCP server, but none of it mentions API versions, version pinning, or a deprecation or sunset policy. With no evidence for the capability, the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
